notes: Perplexity Decisions API (POST https://api.perplexity.ai/v1/decisions; any Perplexity API key; 10 requests per second per organization on every plan). Text, JSON and images (PNG/JPEG/WebP data URLs, up to 2,048 32x32 tiles each; oversize images wait about a minute then 504). Up to 128 questions and under 262,144 input tokens per request (state + images + all questions), body up to 32 MiB. `confidence` is "the model's own certainty estimate ... not the top probability" (a third definition; equals the max probability on a quarter of items per Requesty). "Identical requests usually return identical numbers. Occasionally they differ in the second decimal place, so set thresholds with some margin." Output free, no per-request fee; $0.02/M direct vs $0.04/M on routers.

surfaces.notes: Choice 1-255 options, score levels 1-10 (Perplexity docs). total_tokens 262144 is the documented strict upper bound ("under 262,144"). calibration_claimed null: the README says predict() "applies the saved calibration temperature" but Perplexity publishes no calibration metric. Open weights (Apache-2.0) need about 49 GiB and custom PyTorch code (readout head, noncausal attention; no llama.cpp export).
Same Decisions API; v1.1 adds a noncausal full-attention mode and more training data. HF repo access conflict (card says private; HF API showed gated:false).
OpenRouter perplexity/pplx-decider-v1-27b: context 262,144, max completion 235,929, $0.04/M input, completion $0. Requesty lists 262K and <=128 questions at $0.04/M.
